summary: Add opt-in exact completion cache with native replay receipts (S5)

delivery.outcome: Opt-in exact completion reuse with scope-bound keys, current acceptance checks, separate source usage and native replay receipts without new inference usage.
nonGoals: No tool, mutation, CLI, adaptive or semantic cache.
No live paid inference, PyPI publication, S6 or S7 changes.

architecture.decision: Compose the existing optional procache dependency with native routing, response validation and archive commit acknowledgments. Never retry inference because cache storage failed. Replay archives are operations, not billed provider attempts.
interfaceChanges: Add CompletionCache configuration, immutable CompletionCacheReceipt, response.cache and optional complete(cache=..., force_generation=...) arguments.

dataChanges.description: Private TTL entries in existing procache SQLite format; native completion_replay records use existing InteractionStore schema.

architecture.rollback: Disable the opt-in cache or revert the additive adapter; native inference audit and usage remain unchanged.

commands: Synthetic loopback HTTP and persistent native archive/journal readback
validation.evidence: One HTTP, one billed attempt, distinct source/replay IDs across cache restart.

commands: Exact key, quality, force-generation and excluded-effects tests
validation.evidence: No cross-account or stale-policy reuse; rejected cache candidates cannot escape validation.

commands: Concurrent, cancellation, corruption, expiry and write-failure fault tests
validation.evidence: No extra provider call after successful inference due to a cache fault.

commands: Protected OneDev and independent exact-head publication
validation.evidence: Preserved uncached routing, S3 generation accounting and S4 receipts.
